fields: L4 Beijing / Chinese New Year (tricycle; Shichahai hutong → Chang'an Avenue → Summer Palace). Same item fields as L3 v3.1. Pools keep L3 names so pickSetL2 + l3TypeUniq can be reused: seawall = Lantern Riddle Stand 灯谜摊 questions (3–4 choices, timed 30 s; also the retry pool), forest_fork = Chang'an Avenue fork signs (≤3 choices; sign_en/sign_zh; EN ≤24 chars, ZH width ≤12), peak_final = Seventeen-Arch Bridge final 十七孔桥终极题 (exactly 4 choices, hard, situational). Per run: 5 riddle-stand + 4 fork + 1 final = 10. Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Lantern riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'). Stems are deduped against all L1–L3 banks (all grades).

Strontium salts; excited electrons emit red light as they drop
choices_zh: 锶盐；受激电子回落时放出红光
questions.explain_zh: 锶的发射光谱在红光区。

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A lantern-string curve over the bridge is h(x) = 6x^4. What is its slope h'(-1)?
questions.q_zh: 桥上一串彩灯的曲线是 h(x) = 6x^4，它在 x = -1 处的斜率 h'(-1) 是多少？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Lanterns on the bridge are lit at a rate of r(t) = 4t lanterns per minute for 0 ≤ t ≤ 6. How many lanterns are lit in total?
questions.q_zh: 桥上灯笼按 r(t) = 4t 盏/分钟的速率点亮，0 ≤ t ≤ 6，一共点亮多少盏？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: At the bridge, Flora may pick 2 of 9 different lanterns to carry home. Order does not matter. How many different sets can she pick?
questions.q_zh: 在桥上，Flora 可以从 9 盏不同的灯笼里挑 2 盏带回家，不计顺序，有多少种挑法？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: On the bridge, Flora guesses 5 lantern riddles, each with a 1/2 chance of being right, independently. What is the probability she gets exactly 3 right?
questions.q_zh: 在桥上，Flora 猜 5 条灯谜，每条猜对的概率都是 1/2，互不影响。恰好猜对 3 条的概率是多少？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: The bridge's lantern rows hold 7, 10, 13 lanterns and so on, 6 rows in all. How many lanterns are there in total?
questions.q_zh: 桥上灯笼一排比一排多：7、10、13，依此类推，一共 6 排，总共多少盏？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Lantern strings on the bridge are hung in rounds: 5 lanterns in the first round, then 3 times as many each round, for 5 rounds. How many lanterns in total?
questions.q_zh: 桥上灯笼分轮挂：第一轮 5 盏，之后每轮是上一轮的 3 倍，共 5 轮，一共多少盏？
